description: **New feature.** Initial openstream package with JSON streaming protocol SDK, direct Azure OpenAI backend, and openstream-stop command.
**New feature.** Gateway integration with renamed Azure fields, fixed URL routing, and auth/body handling.
**Bug fix.** Increase subprocess buffer to 10MB for large tool outputs and use DEVNULL for stdin to prevent blocking.
**New feature.** Tool registration framework with @tool decorator, Tool dataclass, collect_tools(), and JSON Schema generation from type hints
**New feature.** Agent definition loading with discovery, prompt resolution, and YAML-based agent definitions
**New feature.** Context injection in DirectClient and PipelineContext for dynamic prompt variable substitution
**New feature.** Agent invocation with invoke_agent and invoke_agent_sync for running agent definitions end-to-end
**New feature.** Refactor DirectClient to use dynamic tool dispatch from registered tools
**New feature.** Extract builtin tools to standalone functions in _builtin_tools.py
**New feature.** Finalize SessionConfig and public API surface for openstream
**New feature.** Environment variable isolation filters sensitive vars from bash tool subprocesses with exported ENV_BLOCKLIST
**Bug fix.** Literal schema type inference correctly handles int/float/bool values
**Bug fix.** glob_files now respects cwd parameter instead of always using process working directory
**Bug fix.** Preserve empty tools list instead of conflating with None
**Bug fix.** Derive builtin tool names dynamically and remove overridden names from builtin set
